reasons: Evidence-only governance correction; no product or documentation content changes.

acceptance: Add one requirement-evidence record bound exactly to origin/main a3cf1deda0d9577817b2ffeb8078068f77f48340, retiring only the two observed test-weakening signals for tests/test_documentation_comprehension_results.py.
Record explicit user authorization and the CI failure source; do not change documentation content, tests, policy logic, or release metadata.

Prefer the smallest reversible governance-only change; preserve the original PR and its audit trail.

intent.problem: PR #835 changed the comprehension result test names, so hosted template-smoke reports test_case_removed and negative_test_removed relative to effective base a3cf1deda0d9577817b2ffeb8078068f77f48340. Existing evidence is bound to Work Item base 3305e2ba and is rejected by CI.
constraints: Only add the base-bound evidence record and lifecycle records required to govern this correction.
Do not weaken or modify the checker, tests, documentation content, or release version.
The corrective PR targets the existing feature branch so PR #835 keeps the same effective base while CI is repaired.
intent.rationale: A narrowly bound evidence receipt preserves fail-closed governance while acknowledging the explicitly authorized test rename in the already-reviewed documentation PR.
